items.title: Podcast signal uses only recent episodes
items.headline: Podcast mentions now count only if a company was discussed in the last 30 days, so stale chatter no longer colours a stock's score.
items.summary: The podcast-signals spec ("Qualitative signal for scoring") says tickers with no transcript in the last 30 days get no signal

items.title: Documentation brought back in line with behaviour
items.headline: Mismatches between the written rules and what the system actually does were reviewed, and each was resolved.
items.summary: Decide each item, then either record it in a spec delta or fix the code with a test

items.title: Unfinished work blocks closing a change
items.headline: A change can no longer be marked done while tasks are still open, unless they are only waiting for new data.
items.summary: In project_setup.openspec_gate.archive_change, before any delta merges
added: openspec_gate archive <id> SHALL refuse a change whose tasks.md holds an unchecked task without an awaits-data condition, and SHALL list those tasks in its output. Open awaits-data tasks do not block archive; archive defers them to openspec/changes/DATA_WATCH.md.

Every archive refusal (failing gate, open task, archive target already exists) SHALL happen before any spec delta is merged, so a refused archive leaves openspec/specs/ and the change folder unchanged.

items.title: Weekly scorecard now uses full strategy replay
items.headline: The weekly scorecard and the live-versus-history check now replay the whole strategy, not just prices, for a fairer view of how it performs.
items.summary: Retire the price-only walk-forward as an evaluation of the strategy and point both of its consumers at the replay engine.

items.title: Fairer test before new strategies go live
items.headline: New strategies are now compared with the current one while holding the same number of stocks, and no longer pay trading costs for positions you would simply keep.
items.summary: The promotion test can pass a challenger for the wrong reason, and the replay book charges costs the owner would never pay.
added: When a replay position reaches its exit horizon and the name is still a BUY on that step under the same policy, the replay book SHALL keep the position open with no fill and no cost, and restart its horizon clock. Target and stop exits SHALL be unaffected.

The promotion test's NAV leg SHALL compare champion and challenger at the same mean number of names held, by re-deciding the wider arm's cached scores at the BUY line that matches the other arm's mean count.
A challenger SHALL pass the NAV leg only if it beats the champion at matched exposure. The unmatched NAV delta SHALL still be reported beside the matched one on the promotion log row.

items.title: Tests kept away from the live price database
items.headline: Automated tests now use a separate temporary price store, so they can't block the daily price update.
items.summary: The root conftest.py sets INVESTOR_MARKET_DB to a per-process tmp store before anything imports investor
added: The test suite SHALL NOT open the live bar store. Every test process SHALL resolve the bar-store path to its own temporary store. A test run whose default bar-store path still resolves to the live store SHALL refuse to start, so a test can never take the write lock that the pulse's bar_refresh and surge_detector stages need.

The test suite SHALL NOT run the one-time legacy in-tree bar-store migration against its throwaway temporary store, so a surviving data/market_data.db is never moved into a store that is deleted when the test process exits.

items.title: Missed daily update is rerun automatically
items.headline: If the daily data update is skipped or interrupted, for example after a reboot, it is detected and rerun within hours.
items.summary: Add scan_pulse_freshness to investor.project_setup.healer
added: The healer checks daily pulse freshness. When the newest completed daily run log row (stage-failure rows do not count) is older than 26 hours, it raises an ERROR job-freshness finding for investor-pulse.service and queues a pulse rerun through the safe restart_service fix, which leaves an active run alone. A catch-up run that a reboot or sleep killed, and that systemd's persistent timer therefore counts as consumed, is recovered within one healer interval instead of waiting for the next calendar slot. A host without a run log produces no finding.

items.title: Price updates wait out database conflicts
items.headline: When two jobs want the price database at once, the second now waits its turn instead of failing, so fewer daily price updates are lost.
items.summary: market_data.connect retries a lock conflict, and only a lock conflict, with doubling sleeps (1s, 2s, 4s, capped at 10s) until a bounded wait runs out: 120 seconds by default, overridable with INVESTOR_MARKET_DB_LOCK_WAIT_S
added: Opening the bar store SHALL wait out a file lock held by another process instead of failing at once. DuckDB lets one writing process hold the file, and while it does a second process cannot open it even read-only. The wait SHALL be bounded: 120 seconds by default, overridable with INVESTOR_MARKET_DB_LOCK_WAIT_S (0 disables the wait).
Only the cross-process lock conflict SHALL be retried. Any other open error SHALL be raised at once.

When the wait runs out, the original lock-conflict error SHALL be raised unchanged, so an existing fail-soft caller still records the failed stage (for the pulse, the bar_refresh stage failure the healer reports).
The store SHALL log when it starts waiting on a lock, when the lock clears, and when it gives up, so a run log shows contention that delayed or failed a refresh.

items.title: Warning when a history check includes unreliable data
items.headline: The comparison between live and replayed scores now warns when it has scored categories that cannot be reliably replayed.
items.summary: ParityReport.unreplayable_populated lists the unreplayable categories that any joined replay row scored, and format_report prints a WARNING line naming them
added: A parity report SHALL name every category the policy lists as unreplayable that the replay scored on any joined row, and its rendered output SHALL carry a warning naming them, because parity removes those categories from the audit side only.

items.title: Gross profit filled in for more companies
items.headline: When a company doesn't report gross profit, it is now worked out from its cost lines, giving you margin trends for more stocks.
items.summary: When GrossProfit is untagged, derive gross_profit from the first tagged of CostOfSales, RawMaterialsAndConsumablesUsed and CostOfMerchandiseSold (absolute value, as before), listed in derived
added: When a filing tags no GrossProfit, annual_statements SHALL derive gross_profit as revenue less the absolute value of the first tagged of CostOfSales, RawMaterialsAndConsumablesUsed and CostOfMerchandiseSold, in that order, and list gross_profit in derived.

A margin derived from a nature-of-expense line is a proxy for the gross margin: it SHALL be fit for year-over-year direction and multi-year span, and SHALL NOT be presented as the vendor's reported gross margin level.

items.title: Wrong-company insider trades cleaned out
items.headline: Insider transactions that were filed under the wrong company have been removed from the stored history, so each stock shows only its own insiders' trades.
items.summary: purge_foreign_insider_events re-reads every bronze fi_insider_register capture (3,698 pages), applies the live select_issuer_rows rule per ticker, and removes a fi_daily row whose key (instrument, trade date, person, value) matches only another issuer's rows
added: A host command SHALL remove from silver insider_events each source_basis=fi_daily row whose key matches only bronze register rows of another issuer under the live issuer rule; back-fill (fi_history) rows and rows no capture covers SHALL be kept. Re-running it SHALL change nothing.

items.title: Insider trades found by company name too
items.headline: When searching by ticker only turns up other companies' filings, the app now searches by company name, so more genuine insider trades show up.
items.summary: When a stem search returns rows and every one belongs to another issuer, update_transactions repeats the search with the instrument master's company name (trailing share-class letter dropped) and keeps the rows that pass select_issuer_rows
added: When the ticker-stem search returns rows and none belongs to the ticker's issuer, the update SHALL repeat the search with the instrument master's company name (trailing share-class letter dropped) and keep the rows that belong to the ticker's issuer.
A stem search that returns no rows SHALL NOT be repeated by name.

items.title: Insider trades matched to the right company
items.headline: Insider filings are now stored only when they belong to the stock's own company, and wrongly attributed ones are removed.
items.summary: The live FI insider importer (short_positions/fi.py) searches Insynsregistret's Utgivare field with the ticker stem (_ticker_to_search_term: SAVE.ST → SAVE, CAT-B.ST → CAT)
added: A fetched register row SHALL be stored under a ticker only when its ISIN is the ticker's ISIN, or its issuer name (legal form, share-class letters and diacritics ignored) equals the instrument master's company name or the issuer of a fetched row filed under the ticker's ISIN. Other share classes of the same company and rows under a pre-split ISIN are therefore kept; filings of a different company matched by the substring company search are not.

The ticker's ISIN SHALL come from data/isin_map.yaml, else from the instrument master. A ticker with neither SHALL NOT be queried, and its held rows SHALL be dropped. This supersedes fi-isin-gate-fix's rule that a ticker without an ISIN entry is fetched by ticker-derived search term.
A held row that a fresh fetch attributes to another issuer SHALL be removed from the history, and the update SHALL log the count of removed rows and the names of the discarded issuers.

items.title: Dividend history now covers actual payouts
items.headline: The app now stores each stock's real dividend dates and amounts, giving historical tests a fuller dividend record that only uses what was known at the time.
items.summary: silver_v5 builds Graham's dividend record from the dividends_paid line of silver annual_statements, which starts at FY2021 (ESEF)
added: The Yahoo share-history capture SHALL also store each ticker's dividend events (ex-date and amount per share, as served), over the same span as its split history: the full record on backfill, the last two years on the weekly refresh.

Silver dividend_events SHALL hold one row per ex-date per source, with ex_date as time column, the amount per share, source and observed_at. An event's amount SHALL come from the newest capture that holds it and its observed_at from the first; each import rebuilds only its own source's rows.
A paid dividend is not restated, so the ex-date SHALL be the event's visibility boundary, including for an event first captured after it.

items.title: Cleanup saves unfinished work first
items.headline: Before an old working copy is removed, its unsaved changes are now backed up, so nothing in progress is lost.
items.summary: Before reaping, src/investor/worktree.py writes the worktree's uncommitted tracked diff (staged and unstaged) to $XDG_STATE_HOME/investor/preserved-worktrees/<worktree>.patch, outside every checkout
added: Before the stale-worktree reaper removes a job worktree, it saves that worktree's uncommitted tracked changes as a patch in host-local state outside every checkout. If the patch cannot be saved, the worktree is left in place.

items.title: Evidence required before changing the value-score budget
items.headline: Before a strategy change alters how much the value score counts, you now see how much came from costs versus stock picking, and which live actions would flip.
items.summary: Decompose the NAV delta, explain the turnover, and measure what the change would do to today's live actions
added: Before a challenger that cleared the promotion test changes a live budget, the evidence SHALL separate its NAV delta into a cost part and a selection part, read over sub-periods, and SHALL state the live actions the change would flip.

items.title: Historical tests use realistic trading costs
items.headline: Past simulations now charge the real measured buy–sell gap for each stock, not an overly pessimistic cost, so backtest results are more trustworthy.
items.summary: Every replay fill before 2026-08 paid the widest cost tier, at a spread about ten times the quoted one

items.title: Disclosure signal tracked on its true score
items.headline: The live check of how well the disclosure signal predicts returns now reads its real score instead of a zero left by its switched-off weight.
items.summary: weekly_cross_sections pairs disclosure_metabolism on the signals_used value, the unweighted raw score, and drops the weighted zero
added: A live category IC SHALL NOT read a category value that is its configured-weight contribution while that weight is zero. Such a category SHALL pair on its unweighted recorded score, and a row without that score SHALL stay unpaired.

items.title: Documentation mismatches reviewed and settled
items.headline: Differences between the written rules and the actual behaviour of the second-opinion review were decided one by one and recorded.
items.summary: For each item, the engineer decides whether the code or the spec is wrong, then either fixes the code (with a test) or amends the spec with a delta that records the decision
added: The contribution of a heuristic panel verdict to the composite SHALL be stated once and SHALL match the code; a spec, code comment or capability summary that says otherwise is a defect.
The persona model, timeout and LLM-unavailable alert name SHALL each be recorded by a delta when they change.
Code that survives this capability's retirement and still runs in the daily pipeline SHALL have a named owning capability, or SHALL stop being called. No surviving path places an order.
The supply-chain concentration signal's size, source name, gate field and minimum edge count SHALL be stated in this spec and SHALL match the code.

items.title: Documentation updated with recent decisions
items.headline: The written description of the second-opinion review now reflects the decisions made in the latest documentation review.
items.summary: Restate the four subsections with the recorded decisions, under headings that merge.

items.title: Seasonality no longer sways recommendations
items.headline: The calendar-pattern signal is now only observed and recorded, so it can't push a recommendation until it proves itself.
items.summary: Add seasonality to ZERO_WEIGHT_NUDGE_SIGNALS, the treatment score_momentum_4w and index_boundary got on 2026-08-15

items.title: Historical tests read financial statements like live
items.headline: Past-score tests now use the same gross profit, debt, equity and share figures as the live app, so value and quality scores match.
items.summary: silver_v5 replay scored graham and consistency one-sidedly below the live audit: median -125 and -100 on 2026-10-26, on the same side for most names (IDEAS 20261101-03)
added: silver_v5 SHALL serve the live statement rows for gross profit, long-term debt, total debt including lease liabilities, tangible book and year-end shares, so the F-Score and Graham tests read the same inputs as live where a filing tags them.

A line no filing tags SHALL stay unknown. Tangible book SHALL NOT fall back to equity when intangibles are untagged. Total debt SHALL stay unknown when a filing tags lease liabilities but no borrowings.
Year-end shares SHALL come from the split-adjusted silver share_counts reading at each fiscal year end, unknown where that series does not reach.
The dividend record SHALL read every fiscal year visible at the decision instant, not only the four-year statement window.

items.title: Better reading of early company warnings
items.headline: Pre-announcement press releases are now classified by their headline first, so profit warnings and upgrades are less often misread.
items.summary: The pa-rubric-v1 body-wide keyword match never met real body text until the 2026-11-01 re-capture gave 1,937 of 1,940 MAR releases their body
added: A direction phrase in the release title SHALL decide the direction.
With no title phrase, a release whose title announces a corporate transaction SHALL read unclassified, whatever its body says.
Any other release SHALL take its direction from the body.

items.title: Cash-flow and enterprise-value ratios in history tests
items.headline: Historical tests now compute price-to-free-cash-flow and enterprise-value ratios from data known at the time, so those ratios can be properly evaluated.
items.summary: In replay/fundamentals_history.py
added: silver_v5 SHALL serve p_fcf as market cap over the latest visible fiscal year's operating cash flow less capex, absent when that free cash flow is not positive.

silver_v5 SHALL serve ev_ebitda and ev_to_sales from market cap plus the latest net debt published by the decision instant, absent when no net debt is published. Fiscal-year lines SHALL NOT stand in for net debt.

items.title: Waiting-for-you items flagged in the watch list
items.headline: Open items that depend on a person's action are now flagged, and the research page's freshness check reads the newest published date.
added: openspec_gate watch SHALL flag ACTOR on an entry whose ready condition names a person or an action, including hand-labelling and hand-grading, whatever the entry's age or named dates.
The check lint on awaits-data conditions SHALL use the same pattern.
t5_research_page_freshness SHALL read the newest generated_at stamp among the checkout's research export and the published site's research data. It is UNMEASURED only when neither is readable.

items.title: Balance-sheet figures read from company reports
items.headline: Equity, net debt, cash and total assets are now pulled from the report attached to each company release, with the newest reports read first.
items.summary: report_key_figures.equity_msek, net_debt_msek, cash_msek, cfo_period_msek and total_assets_msek are null on all 4,972 rows
added: The daily key-figure refresh also reads balance-sheet lines, bounded per run and by the usage meter, newest releases first, so a report published today is read ahead of the historical queue and the back-fill drains without a manual run. Silver is rebuilt when a run reads any line.

items.title: Annual figures read in the right unit
items.headline: Annual statement amounts and quarterly-report figures are now on the same scale, so valuation ratios in historical tests are no longer distorted.
items.summary: Read annual lines as they stand; only report_key_figures *_msek columns are scaled
added: The silver_v5 provider SHALL read annual_statements monetary lines in whole currency units and report_key_figures *_msek columns in millions, so market ratios built from either source are on one scale.

items.title: Correct Wikipedia pages tracked for each company
items.headline: Each company is now tied to its right Wikipedia article, including redirects and history, so the public-attention measure reflects the right company.
items.summary: data_lake/sources/wikipedia_pageviews.py guessed each company's article title from its trading name (article_title("Midsummer AB") -> "Midsummer")

items.title: Ownership signals fed with fuller data
items.headline: Short-seller positions are now saved every day and share counts kept up to date, so the ownership-durability signal has data to score on.
items.summary: ownership_durability registered three stock blocks, and only one has ever scored
added: FI's current short register ("Aktuella positioner") SHALL be captured to bronze on every pulse, under source fi_short_register, key aktuella_positioner.

Silver short_holder_positions SHALL hold one row per holder, instrument and capture day (instrument_id, date, holder, percent_of_shares, position_date). date is the capture day. An as-of read SHALL use the newest snapshot on or before the date across all issuers, so an issuer that left the register reads as having no holders.

The weekly yfinance_shares_full refresh SHALL also store Yahoo's live company-level share count as a reading dated the capture day, unless the history already has a reading for that day, so a name whose history has stopped stays dated. A missing live count leaves the history as served. The backfill stores history only. In silver the live reading is a company-scope reading and passes the glitch filter like any other.
Product invariants SHALL flag any eligible shadow block with no scored observation in the last 7 days over at least 50 rows.

items.title: More complete earnings dates
items.headline: Report dates published by companies now take priority over estimates, and missing dates are re-checked every run, so reporting blackouts are caught sooner.
items.summary: In earnings_calendar.py and data_lake/sources/mfn_calendar.py
added: Among fallback sources for an earnings date, issuer-published report dates SHALL rank above estimated dates, and an estimated next date SHALL be tried before storing null.
The issuer calendar lookup SHALL use a verified issuer identifier where one exists, for any listing venue, before any identifier derived from the name.
The daily refresh SHALL re-read entries with a null date on every run, so a date published inside the cache TTL reaches the T2 blackout on the next run.

items.title: Data-watch list flags items that are due
items.headline: Entries waiting for data are now marked as due once their expected date has arrived.
items.summary: watch prints DUE on an entry whose newest named date has arrived
added: openspec_gate watch SHALL flag DUE an entry whose newest date named in its ready condition has arrived, unless the entry is already STALE. The (since ...) stamp SHALL NOT count as a named date. An undated condition SHALL carry no DUE flag.

items.title: Annual report source stays as is
items.headline: The Swedish company registry's annual-report files won't be added for listed companies, since they would add only a couple of missing companies.
items.summary: Bronze capture of the HVD annual-report and company base data (raw, dated, immutable), then silver fundamentals built with the same statement extraction and accuracy gate that the ESEF path uses, for companies that the instrument master or the delisted-company list identifies
added: Silver annual fundamentals SHALL stay on the ESEF source. The Bolagsverket annual-report bulk files SHALL NOT be captured for listed issuers while they add fewer FY issuers than the cost of a second extraction path justifies; the 2026-10-30 count was 2 new issuers of 17 missing.
An issuer's organisation number SHALL be taken from a registry-backed record and pass the checksum. A name match SHALL NOT establish one.

items.title: Owner-flow signal tested for predictive power
items.headline: A pre-planned test checks whether owner buying and selling leads share-price moves, and the published notes now state the result.
items.summary: Pre-register the test as spike S23, fetch Yahoo closes for every member into a research cache beside the bar store (the bar store and its T8 denominator stay untouched), run it with owner_flow.lead_test and scripts/evaluate_owner_flow_lead.
added: The published owner-flow method notes state the result of the owner-flow lead test (spike S23): whether group flow or the safety barometer led group returns at the pre-registered bar, and the date tested.
A kill leaves every projection labelled descriptive and unvalidated.

items.title: Warning for waiting tasks that need a person
items.headline: Tasks that claim to wait for data but actually depend on someone's action now trigger a warning.
items.summary: An (awaits-data: ...) ready condition must name data a later run can check
added: openspec_gate check warns on an open task whose awaits-data ready condition names an actor (owner, human, operator, reviewer, manual action, the host engineer running something, the healer resyncing, applying or fixing something, or a ratification) rather than data a later run can check. The warning does not fail the gate.

items.title: Cleaner idea list and room to grow
items.headline: Follow-up notes that need no action are no longer added to the idea list, and large summaries keep room to grow.
items.summary: Two frictions are each logged twice or more in openspec/orchestration/improvement-log.md, so the engineer contract (§9) makes their root-cause fix the next normal pass's first work (handoff in the 2026-10-28 prompt-evolution entry)
added: A generated capability node whose size exceeds 80% of the node token budget lists each sub-package's member modules by name on that sub-package's line, rather than one line per module, so a capability can grow by a module without failing the budget check.

When openspec_gate archive harvests Follow-up bullets into IDEAS.md, it skips a bullet that states nothing needs doing: one that starts with "None" or "N/A", or that records a "no backfill needed" / "no backfill, because" decision, including on a wrapped continuation line.
The harvest treats a bullet as already present in IDEAS.md when it matches an existing line after whitespace is collapsed, so a re-wrapped bullet is not appended twice.

items.title: Cash-flow warning only when it's true
items.headline: A stock's investment summary now says free cash flow is negative only when the latest year's cash flow really is negative.
items.summary: _build_thesis_stub (src/investor/report.py) keeps "FCF negative — speculative entry" for a non-resilient name whose latest-year FCF margin is ≤ 0
